payload.description: Lets your Agents score a choice locally and say how sure they are. It is a decision scorer, not a chatbot. Kev does not chat. You give it a situation and a question, and it answers with numbers: which option fits best, where something falls on a scale, or how likely a statement is, each with a confidence level. It runs on your own NVIDIA GPU inside WSL 2 and needs about 20 GB of model downloads. Its answers are advice, never orders.
